name: Coloretto
summary: Drafting card game where players collect colors, scoring plus for three best colors and minus for the rest.
rules_text: A shuffled supply contains colored cards, +2 cards, jokers, and a last-round card inserted 15 cards from the bottom. Each round there is one row marker per player in the center, each row can hold up to 3 cards. On your turn you must either draw the top supply card and place it face up onto any row with <3 cards, or take one row that has at least one card, adding its marker and all its cards face up to your tableau sorted by color, then you sit out the rest of the round. If all rows are full you must take a row; if all but one player have taken, the last player may keep placing. When all players have taken a row, return markers to center and start a new round with the player who took last. When the last-round card is drawn the current round is the final round. At end assign each joker to any color you own. Each color scores from a table by count (e.g.1=1,2=3,3=6,4=10,5=15,6=21), you choose your best 3 colors to score positive, all others negative. Each +2 card is +2. Most points wins. For 2 players and 3 players remove colors and use different row capacities.
